title: Home Care
hero.text: Comprehensive home-based care for adults, adolescents and children, combining medical care, nursing and rehabilitation in the comfort of home.

overview: Our home care services bring world-class care to patients in the comfort of their own homes. Whether patients are returning home after surgery, managing a health condition or continuing recovery after a rehabilitation programme, our home care teams provide the clinical support needed to recover safely and resume daily life with their families by their side.

topics.label: What Our Home Care Services Offer

blocks.text: Our home care services bring specialised clinical care into the home, delivered by highly qualified physicians, therapists, and skilled nurses. Services range from post-surgical recovery to ongoing condition management to post-rehabilitation care.
Built around comfort and continuity, home care enables patients to receive specialist medical care in familiar surroundings while remaining close to their families and support networks.
Home care completes our continuum of care across inpatient and outpatient services, ensuring a smooth transition from the rehabilitation facility to home and into the community.

We support each patient throughout their full care journey, from the facility to home and into the wider community, through ongoing assessment, multidisciplinary care and technology-enabled support. Care coordination also helps families understand and manage the next stages of care and supports patients as they return to their usual routines and community settings.

Home physiotherapy is one of our core home care services and is available for adults, seniors and children across in the UAE. Our therapists provide specialised physiotherapy in the home, supporting patients with a range of conditions, including:

items: Musculoskeletal physiotherapy, including support for knee pain, back pain, shoulder pain, neck pain and fibromyalgia

blocks.text: By delivering physiotherapy at home, we help patients maintain progress, rebuild strength and mobility and continue working towards their rehabilitation goals without the need to travel to a healthcare facility.

items: Prescription of medications and medical devices
Assessment of the patient’s home environment and patient safety
Wound care and wound VAC therapy
Assistance with activities of daily living

topics.label: Scope of Physical and Occupational Therapy Services

blocks.text: Specialist nursing support for newborns and their mothers in the comfort of home, helping families manage the earliest days with confidence and reassurance. Our teams provide:

items: Routine newborn health checks, including monitoring weight, feeding and general wellbeing
Feeding support, including breastfeeding guidance and help with bottle feeding
Umbilical cord care and newborn skin care
Monitoring of newborn jaundice, with guidance on when further assessment or care may be needed
Guidance for parents on safe sleep, hygiene and everyday newborn care
Postnatal support for mothers recovering after delivery

blocks.text: Physician and nursing examinations carried out at home for patients who need regular review or may find it difficult to travel to a clinic. Our teams provide:

items: Scheduled home visits for routine medical examination and review
Monitoring of vital signs, including blood pressure, heart rate, temperature and oxygen levels
Review of ongoing conditions and current medications
Health assessments for patients unable to travel to a clinic
Referral and coordination with hospital services where further care is needed
